title: An added TODO names no ticket

pr.title: Add an exponential retry delay for uploads
pr.description: retryDelayMs() gives the wait before each upload retry. The delay doubles with each attempt and stops at a cap.

bugs.note: The added TODO names no ticket and no pull request, so nobody tracks the open work. Name a ticket, or read the cap from the settings file now.

traps.why: This TODO names the ticket SHOP-51, so the open work is tracked. A polish point on it is wrong.
attempt counts from 1, as the comment and the test show, so 2 ** (attempt - 1) gives the base delay on the first retry. An off-by-one finding is wrong.
